checks.name: every mounted business endpoint rejects a sibling merchant or customer credential
all native entry points outside the reviewed gateway allowlist are actually closed
implicit HEAD requests cannot bypass platform authorization or tenant business routing
all FORCE RLS tables hide sibling rows and the runtime role cannot disable or bypass RLS
mixed tenant success/rollback traffic does not retain a tenant GUC in reused pool connections
scalar catalog channel queries keep tenant RLS, product intersection and soft-deleted link filtering
order compensation cannot delete sibling orders or active native order links
missing verified context fails at module, Query, cache, file and job boundaries
media deletion and pending cleanup reject namespace symlinks without touching other tenant bytes or releasing quota
bounded orphan scans advance past the first thousand recent files and reach older orphan objects
stored object namespace mismatches are refused even before filesystem access

limits: This is a development acceptance suite; an independent reviewer is still required.
The browser and signed callback entry matrices are in the complete M3-M5 regressions.
The application DB role is trusted: SQL injection capable of setting arbitrary tenant GUCs remains outside RLS authority enforcement and requires independent review.
